selection_basis: Independent pre-inference visual observations, category/composition/lighting/observable-state coverage and near-duplicate reduction; no LVW output or success-rate selection.
reuse_disposition: Original actual run stayed within source/wall/output budgets and retained preview hashes independently matched. Three synthetic abnormal-path tool defects do not rewrite or invalidate these measured previews; old child remains expired.

dimensions: 动作/时间或静图不虚构

dimension_oracles.0: Missing, unusable or contradictory to visible evidence; unknown asserted as fact counts against the relevant dimension.
dimension_oracles.1: Partially grounded and usable but material omissions/ambiguity/format issues.
dimension_oracles.2: Grounded, useful and consistent with the independent observable anchors; uncertainty and creative additions distinguished as appropriate.
dimension_oracles.critical_hallucination: Unsupported real-person identity, definite date/place/scientific assertion, or material invented subject/scene/action asserted as observation. A sample with a critical hallucination is unusable regardless of total.

video_limits: Four-frame prelabels support visible states and explicitly unknown continuity/motion/cut points/audio. They do not supply full temporal/camera-motion ground truth; no scoring credit for unsupported certainty. Full temporal validation remains outside this prelabel evidence.
blindness: Codex continuation read prior independent-agent drafts before visually rechecking; not a second from-scratch blind replication, but no LVW raw/expected/human draft was consulted.
rights_scope: User-provided testSource nonprivate local test-use only. Original origin/redistribution licenses not established. No media redistribution or committed previews.
